items.title: The functor associating a quasi-coherent module on a scheme to a module on its site is fully faithful
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme S and a topology among Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf, the lemma states that each of the functors sending a quasi-coherent module to the associated module on the big site or the small site of that topology is fully faithful (statement lines 2675-2688). The proof identifies the functor with a pullback along a morphism of ringed sites, observes that its right adjoint is restriction along the inclusion of the small Zariski site into the site in question, and then computes the induced map on Hom sets through the adjunction: the right adjoint followed by the left adjoint returns the original quasi-coherent module, which turns the string of identifications of Hom sets into the identity on Hom sets of quasi-coherent modules on S, giving full faithfulness (proof lines 2690-2712). The claim is H2: the argument is short but it is a complete derivation, consisting of an identification of the functor with a pullback, an identification of its right adjoint, and a chain of adjunction identifications that has to be written out correctly.
